_capture.what: Access rules and the one advertised endpoint that does not resolve. Captured because the documentation cites both, and a cited fact must be in evidence.
_capture.method: read-only GET, one request at a time, identifying User-Agent
_capture.user_agent_note: Probes were made with an operator User-Agent carrying a real contact address, as robots etiquette expects. The address is redacted in these committed artefacts; it is not the literal string sent.

advertised_endpoint_that_404s.why_it_matters: A body can advertise a collection URL that does not resolve. The harvester treats this as a per-body failure, not a run failure.
